name: UI Layer
description: Streamlit web interface serving the teacher and student pages, together with the typed APIClient that fronts every backend endpoint.

name: API Layer
description: FastAPI routers and dependency guards exposing auth, courses, documents, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, classes, and ops endpoints, plus the shared Pydantic request/response contracts in schemas.

name: Agent Orchestration Layer
description: The multi-agent adaptive-learning pipeline: seven specialized agents (curriculum, planner, lesson, quiz, grading, performance, recommendation) with their base class and message bus, orchestrated through the LangGraph-style graph runtime, tool registry, and background ThreadPoolExecutor task runner.

name: Service Layer
description: Domain business logic for AI answer grading, deterministic study-plan scheduling, class analytics aggregation, and student topic-mastery computation.

name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG) Layer
description: RAG stack that parses uploaded textbooks, chunks content, embeds it via query-aware Nemotron vectors, searches pgvector, and maintains the curriculum and student memory stores.

name: LLM Integration Layer
description: Provider-agnostic chat and embedding abstraction registering OpenRouter free-model access (with attribution headers, timeouts, and float encoding) alongside a deterministic offline mock provider.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, courses, curriculum, learning records, conversation memory, and observability, plus the fail-fast PostgreSQL/pgvector engine, pgvector column type, and session management.

name: Application Core
description: FastAPI application factory wiring routers and startup hooks, pydantic-settings configuration loaded from .env, JWT and password-hashing security primitives, and structured logging.

name: Project Configuration & Documentation
description: Root-level project metadata: uv/packaging definition (pyproject.toml), Python version pin, environment-variable template, opencode assistant configuration, analysis ignore file, and the README.
